'''Star Tours Flight 1222''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Storinal]]. The flight was cancelled on the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], when it was originally set to arrive at the spaceport's Gate 1M at 1820 hours and depart again at 1915.
